incidenti_noti: Estonian government websites were temporarily blocked by DDoS attacks querying them several thousand times the normal traffic flow

contesto_generale: In the second quarter of 2022, Estonia continued to face challenges related to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic. The country also took a firm stance against Russia's actions in Ukraine, as evidenced by its decision to close its airspace to all Russian airlines on February 26. Estonia's political landscape experienced a significant shift when the coalition agreement collapsed on June 3 due to a disagreement over a government bill on primary education, leading to the formation of a new three-party coalition government on July 18. Estonia also reported its first case of monkeypox on June 29.
